note: Headless Chromium emulating an iPhone (viewport, isMobile, hasTouch, deviceScaleFactor 3, en-US, UTC, SwiftShader WebGL); not an iPhone, not Safari. Production builds: before = d322439 (before lane T3), after = this lane. Device stores seeded: plan A (3 days, 60 min, Muscle growth) with a Reverse Wrist Curl written "3 × 10–25" on Day 01, as Home stores it; reverse wrist curls in each of the four weeks before last (2, 2, 1 and 2 sets), 6 and 3 hammer curls last week, and this week's hammer curls, wrist curls and reverse wrist curls. Run on 2026-10-23, UTC. Coordinates are CSS px from the top of the screen.

scenes.method: 390 × 844: open Muscles (/?workspace=body), let it settle, tap Specialize, every .js file requested until the map (the 3D model) is drawn; raw bytes as built, gzip -9 of the same files
